About

A little about me.

I'm a WordPress developer in Islamabad with over three years of experience building business websites and e-commerce stores. I connect clean front-end work with fully functional builds, from custom layouts to complete site management.

At Reamarc.io I build WordPress sites from scratch and handle the technical side too: domains and hosting on Hostinger and Namecheap, cPanel business email, files and databases, and staging sites for testing updates before they go live.

My front-end roots are HTML, CSS, Bootstrap and JavaScript, plus CMS work on WordPress, Squarespace and custom Magento 2 CMS blocks.
